AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

PUBLIC COMMENTS FOR ITEMS ON CONSENT AGENDA (Speakers shall be provided up to 3 minutes to speak regarding all topics on the Consent Agenda.)
CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1 - 11) All items under this heading are considered to be routine and will be enacted by one motion, unless a Councilmember or staff requests that an item be removed for separate discussion. Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered immediately following the motion to approve the Consent Agenda.
1.
Waive Further Reading
Recommendation: After the City Attorney has read the title, waive full reading of ordinances considered on this agenda for introduction on first reading or adoption on second reading.
2.
Update on Palos Verdes Beach and Athletic Club Foundation Compliance with American with Disabilities Act (ADA) at the Palos Verdes Beach and Athletic Club
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council continue discussion of this matter to March 28, 2017.
Staff Report
3.
Demands of March 14, 2017
Recommendation: Approve Payment of Motions #1 and #2.
a.
Motion #1 â€“ Payroll Warrant of March 10, 2017
b.
Motion #2 â€“ Warrant Register of March 14, 2017
Demands
4.
Resolution R17-09; Denying the Appeal and Affirming the Planning Commission Approval of WT-142-15, a Wireless Telecommunication Facilities Application for Equipment Within the City Right-of-Way in the Center Median of Palos Verdes Drive West; a Project That is Exempt from CEQA
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution R17-09; denying the appeal and affirming the Planning Commission approval of WT-142-15; Wireless Telecommunication Facilities Application for new equipment within the City right-of-way in the center median of Palos Verdes Drive North. This project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Staff Report
5.
PW-637-16; Completion of Contract for Fire Safety Weed Abatement for FY16-17 and Filing Notice of Completion
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council accept as complete construction contract PW 637-16 FY 16-17; Fire Safety Weed Abatement Project in the amount of $169,311.00, direct the City Clerk's office to file the Notice of Completion, and release the 5% retention 30 days after the County Recorder's office records the Notice of Completion, if no stop notices are filed.
Staff Report
6.
PW-638-16; Completion of Contract for FY16-17 Street Resurfacing Project and Filing Notice of Completion
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council accept as complete construction contract PW 638-16 FY 16-17 Street Resurfacing Project in the amount of $672,543.94, direct the City Clerk's office to file the Notice of Completion, and release the 5% retention 30 days after the County Recorder's office records the Notice of Completion, if no stop notices are filed.
Staff Report
7.
Renewal of Agreement with L.A. County Department of Agricultural Commissioner/Weights and Measures for Continuation of Weed Abatement Services through June 30, 2022
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve renewal of agreement with L.A. County Department of Agricultural Commissioner/Weights and Measures for continuation of weed abatement services through June 30, 2022.
Staff Report
8.
Approval of Five-Year General Services Agreement with L.A. County Through June 30, 2022
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve a five-year General Services Agreement with the County of Los Angeles through June 30, 2022 and authorize the City Manager, his designee, or Director of Public Works to execute any County Sub-agreement for services.
Staff Report
9.
Resolution R17-11; Approving Administering Agency â€“ State Master Agreement No. 00510S and Program Supplement Agreement No. P62 for Funding of the SSARP (Systematic Safety Analysis Report Program)
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the Master Agreement No. 00510S and Program Supplement Agreement No. P62 for funding of the SSARP, and adopt Resolution R17-11, authorizing the Director of Public Works and City Clerk to execute the agreements.
Staff Report
10.
Approval of Amendment No. 1 of Professional Services Agreement Between the City of Palos Verdes Estates and Greg Giles, CPA for Interim Accounting Services
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the proposed Amendment No. 1 to the agreement with Greg Giles, CPA in an amount not to exceed $50,000 for interim services until the vacant Finance Department position is filled, and adopt Resolution R17-10 adjusting the FY16-17 budget.
Staff Report
11.
Resolution R17-12; Reclassification of Financial Services Manager to Senior Accountant
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the reclassification of the Financial Services Manager to Senior Accountant and adopt Resolution R17-12; establishing the salary range and job description within the Management and Confidential Employee group.
Staff Report
PUBLIC HEARING All persons addressing the City Council during public hearings shall be limited to three (3) minutes for comment.
12.
Annual Protest Hearing Declaring that Weeds, Brush, Rubbish and Refuse Upon or in Front of Specified (Improved Private) Properties in the City are a Seasonal and Recurrent Public Nuisance, and Declaring its Intention for the Abatement Thereof
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council open the protest hearing in accordance with Resolution R17-07 for improved properties, and at the conclusion of the hearing, adjust the list according to the protests heard and adopt a minute resolution directing Los Angeles County Fire Department to inspect and abate weeds, brush, rubbish, and refuse as necessary on improved lots contained in the adjusted list.ORDINANCE
Staff Report
ORDINANCE
13.
Ordinance 17-721; Introduction on First Reading Adding Chapter 9.18 Social Host Liability for Parties at Which Underage Drinking Occurs to Title 9 Public Peace, Morals, and Welfare of the Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council introduce upon first reading Ordinance 17-721 adding Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code Chapter 9.18 Social Host Liability to Title 9 Public Peace, Morals, and Welfare.
Staff Report
NEW BUSINESS
14.
Discussion of Budget Strategy for Modifying the Fiscal Year 2017-18 Budget to Accommodate a Reduction of 25% of City Revenue
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council provide input and direction relative to phases 1, 2 and 3; schedule discussion of items listed in phase 1 on April 25, 2017; discuss options and alternatives, and provide direction.
Staff Report
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT on the agenda. Due to state law, no action can be taken by the Council this evening on matters presented under this section. If the Council determines action is warranted, the item may be referred to staff or placed on a future Council agenda.
